state.background: Review the provisional Plan39 V2 production integration of a total/category additive household-size-share correction. For each category c among nine major categories plus Other, baseline[t,c]=B[t,c]*A[2017,c]/B[2017,c] (Other baseline uses the B residual times the 2017 A/B Other ratio). gamma[c]=(A[2025,c]-baseline[2025,c])/(piJan[2025]-piJan[2017]); historical corrected[t,c]=baseline[t,c]+gamma[c]*(piIV4[t]-piIV4[2017]). Total is defined as sum of the corrected categories. Official A values 2017 onward are passed through unchanged. January setai-n and historical IV-4 are distinct vintages; the bridge is provisional, centered at 2017, and not causal or independent forecast evidence. Current public gate intentionally remains closed.
acceptanceCriteria: The household-share input is fail-closed and manifest/hash validated, including source traces and raw January source files.
The endpoint gamma is applied additively by category, sums to the independently computed total gamma, and corrected totals reconcile to category sums.
Only 2005-2016 estimates are corrected; official A values from 2017 onward are retained unchanged.
2011 is identified as synthetic interpolation from unverified 2010/2012 endpoints and remains provisional.
The runtime and analysis fingerprint include the pi2plus artifact and manifest; one-decimal B/A artifact precision is recorded.
The retrospective 2018-2024 comparison identifies 2025 endpoint calibration and is not presented as independent validation.
The official-derived Other-share threshold is not widened; if 2016-2017 exceeds it, estimated publication remains closed with explicit reasons.

For any non-pass, provide a case-specific finding, affected file/requirement, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. implementation.instructions: Does the supplied evidence support accepting this provisional implementation checkpoint as defined, including the fail-closed publication behavior? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied evidence supports acceptance as defined.

criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Implementation information is incomplete; identify missing details or evidence.
criteria.implementation_issue: An implementation issue exists; identify its location, evidence, and correction.
